_note: Refresh engine for Dave's monthly specials. Edit the active entry (or add a new one and set active), then run: node build-special.mjs. That regenerates special/index.html with matching SEO title, meta, Open Graph, and MenuItem/Offer schema. When Dave texts a photo of a new special, Chipper adds/edits the entry here and rebuilds — live in ~1 min.

specials.title: Lobster Roll-Palooza
specials.blurb: Dave's 2nd Annual Lobster Roll-Palooza is back — a celebration of the roll that made us famous. Fresh-picked Maine lobster, never frozen, on a buttered New England bun — hot with buttah or cold, Maine-style — just $20. Pull over on Route 1 and get in on it.
